description: Long-value fixture. Exercises wrapping and layout for a long hyphenated legal name, several other names used, a long multi-line address, a long county name, and a long related-dismissed-counts description. All values obviously synthetic. Protected and outside-party fields stay blank as in canonical.

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Expungement of the court record with reference to a deferred judgment on discharge from probation under Iowa Code section 907.9(4), together with dismissed counts in the same charging instrument and other related dismissed charges arising from the same transaction or occurrence or a common scheme or plan
eligibilityData.waitingPeriodText: Discharge from probation, with all financial obligations in that case paid — duration: none beyond discharge and payment
eligibilityData.reliefFraming: The court record becomes confidential and comes off public access under Iowa Code section 22.7. It is not accessible except by court order. It is not erased, it is not destroyed, and it is not removed from the participant's record.
additionalFacts: There is no participant filing on this branch. The expungement is expected to occur on discharge without an application, and this mechanism sits outside Iowa R. Crim. P. 2.80 through 2.86 and has no Rule 2.86 form.

The deferred judgment itself remains on the state court administrator's deferred judgment docket and is not expunged; that docket is how courts and prosecutors know a deferred judgment was used, and it feeds the two-deferred-judgment limitation in Iowa Code section 901C.3.

The record is not expunged until the restitution, civil penalties, court costs, fees and other financial obligations ordered by the court or assessed by the clerk in the case that includes the deferred judgment are paid, and the participant must check that answer against the clerk's confirmation of the balance in that case number.
